_comment: Single source of truth for servo calibration, speeds and timing.
All pulse widths are in microseconds; the code converts to the Maestro's quarter-microseconds.
Gripper positions A/B/C/D are ~90 degrees apart. B is neutral. From B: C = 90 CW, A = 90 CCW, D = 180 (CW from the face's own perspective).
Calibration values below were verified on hardware 2026-04-03 (no mechanical changes since).
Whole-cube rotations in standard notation. y: R->F (spin like U). x: F->U (tumble like R).
Servo mapping verified on hardware 2026-09-17:
2:B->C, 8:B->A  moves R->F  (= y)      2:B->A, 8:B->C  moves L->F  (= y')
0:B->C, 6:B->A  moves U->F  (= x')     0:B->A, 6:B->C  moves D->F  (= x)
half_turn_by_toggle_comment: When both grippers of the pair are already at A or C (not B/D), a 2 rotation
flips each straight to its opposite letter instead of resetting to B first and
turning again. E.g. after x' (0:C, 6:A), x2 flips to 0:A, 6:C -- exactly the x
target -- in one move. Falls back to two full quarter turns when starting from B.
x enabled and verified on hardware 2026-09-18 (after the rotation-speed sync fix).

_comment: Maestro speed units: 0 = unlimited; otherwise 0.25 us per 10 ms, so 60 = 1500 us/s.
Accel 0-255, 0 = unlimited.
rotation: speed of the gripper with the longer travel during a whole-cube rotation;
the other gripper of the pair is slowed in proportion so both arrive together
(otherwise they twist the cube). 0 = unlimited for both.

timing._comment: Seconds to wait after commanding a move. Open-loop; tune with calibration later.

_comment: crop is [x1, y1, x2, y2] measured on a crop_ref-sized frame and scaled to the capture size.
lock_auto: warm up with auto exposure / white balance, then freeze them for the scan.
exposure / wb_temperature: null = keep whatever auto settled on; set numbers to force.
sequence: 'photo' shoots the face at the front; other entries are cube rotations.
A photo is only valid right after a rotation: the holding pair is then parked at A/C
(out of view) and the other pair is retracted. Claws at B hide the edge stickers.
lighting: one photo per state per face; NullLights ignores the names.
